What Your Report Contains
01
Executive Summary
How a serious buyer would internally frame your company based on your disclosed information.
02
Exit Readiness Score
Recalculated from your 26 inputs — more precise than the free diagnostic score.
03
Buyer-Lens Positioning Memo
How strategics, PE firms, and search funds would each frame your company — what excites them and what concerns them.
04
Revenue Quality Assessment
Underwritability, concentration risk, recurring vs. transactional, customer tenure, pricing power.
05
Founder Dependence & Operational Analysis
Continuity without the founder, management depth, process documentation, key person exposure.
06
Financial Profile Assessment
Earnings quality, margin trajectory, financial cleanliness, facility considerations.
07
Diligence Pressure Map
Where buyer scrutiny will focus first, ranked by severity.
08
Competitive Position & AI Exposure
Defensibility, industry dynamics, how AI reshapes your market position.
09
Timing & Optionality Analysis
Whether delay increases or decreases your leverage, inbound interest assessment.
10
Pre-Market Action Plan
5–8 specific actions ranked by valuation impact with estimated timelines.
11
Uncertainty Disclosure
What the report cannot assess due to missing or withheld inputs.
What To Do Now
Check your inbox — most reports arrive within a few minutes.
